# NIIB Lucknow — course enquiry and campus information

Official landing page: https://niiblucknow.com/

New Image International Beauty Institute (NIIB) presents beauty and related training courses in Lucknow. Prospective students can inquire about makeup artistry, hair designing, beauty artistry (skin), nail techniques, cosmetology, aesthetics, wellness and other courses listed on the website. Individual course availability, recognition, tuition fees, entry requirements, duration and next batch dates must be confirmed with an admissions counsellor.

Contact (shown on supplied Google Business Profile screenshot): +91 93354 90413.
Campus listing: 1st Floor, Taj Plaza, Madan Mohan Malviya Marg, above Mist Hotel, near Krishi Bhawan, Gokhale Vihar, Hazratganj, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226001.

Admissions enquiry: https://niiblucknow.com/#enquire
Campus directions: https://niiblucknow.com/#location
Course list: https://niiblucknow.com/#courses
